name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard covers the box pickup, and Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard matches the 'until the door has been opened once' ban, which the spec requires as Precedence even though key_lost already means 'dropped while closed'. Both clauses are hard, as the task's categorical wording requires, and no added requirement appears.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room (the box named by the mission) at some point.
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: key_lost must not occur before door_open has become true.
